unlisted_practices: Zero-shot LLM prompting to generate synthetic tabular clinical datasets for privacy-preserving data access
Assessing fidelity of LLM-generated synthetic data against a real-world dataset using t-tests, proportion tests, and confidence interval overlap

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility and fidelity of using GPT-4o with zero-shot prompting to generate synthetic tabular clinical datasets compared to real-world perioperative data (VitalDB).
